before.name: close
before.source:
def close(self) -> None:
    """Invoke all close callbacks registered with
        :meth:`call_on_close`, and exit all context managers entered
        with :meth:`with_resource`.
        """
    self._exit_stack.close()
    self._exit_stack = ExitStack()

after.name: close

def close(self) -> None:
    """Invoke all close callbacks registered with
        :meth:`call_on_close`, and exit all context managers entered
        with :meth:`with_resource`.
        """
    self._close_with_exception_info(None, None, None)

before.name: __exit__

after.name: __exit__
after.source:
def __exit__(self, exc_type: type[BaseException] | None, exc_value: BaseException | None, tb: TracebackType | None) -> bool | None:
    self._depth -= 1
    exit_result: bool | None = None
    if self._depth == 0:
        exit_result = self._close_with_exception_info(exc_type, exc_value, tb)
    pop_context()
    return exit_result
